full_prompt_en: The image is a square, loosely brushed oil painting of small figures crossing a pale road beside cottages under a gray sky. The upper third is a broad, nearly featureless warm gray cloud field, lightening slightly above the distant horizon. A cool blue-gray ridge and low roofs stretch across the middle from the far left, with thin utility poles and wires rising as faint linear marks. Near the center-right, two pale cottages stand close to the road. The nearer building faces the viewer with a white gable, dark roof, two small black windows, and a muted red doorway. A second light house sits just behind it, and low darker outbuildings extend toward the right edge. On the upper right horizon, blockier buildings sit farther back on the slope. The road enters from the lower right, passes the front of the houses, and bends into the left distance, where it narrows among the hills. Several tiny dark and muted red figures are spaced along it rather than gathered in one group. One isolated figure stands near the lower right side of the road; pairs and small clusters recede toward the center-left. The left foreground is filled with tall dry golden grass, tangled with deep blue, olive, and brown strokes and a scatter of small white, yellow, and red flower marks. The right foreground is lighter and barer, with a worn narrow track cutting toward the road. Clouded daylight is diffuse and cool, making the white gable and road the brightest connected areas while the grass and outbuildings hold more shadow. The paint is rough and thinly scraped in the gray sky, heavier and more colorful in the foreground growth. Fine dark marks establish figures, windows, and poles without making them overly precise. The viewpoint is slightly raised, allowing the road to lead diagonally from the near edge into a quiet distant settlement. The overall composition balances a broad subdued sky and pale built forms against a lively golden verge, with human scale carried by small scattered silhouettes.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、笔触松散的油画，灰色天空下细小人影穿过乡屋旁的浅色道路。上方三分之一是宽阔、几乎没有细节的暖灰云天，临近远处地平线稍微变亮。冷蓝灰色山脊和低屋顶从最左侧横过中部，细电线杆和线缆以淡淡线痕升起。靠近中央偏右，两座浅色乡屋挨着道路。较近的一座以白色山墙朝向观者，有暗屋顶、两扇小黑窗和一道低饱和红门。第二座浅色房屋在其后，低矮深色附属建筑延伸到右画边。右上方山坡地平线上还有更远的方块建筑。道路从右下进入，经过房屋前方，向左侧远处弯去，在丘陵间逐渐收窄。几名细小的深色和低饱和红色人影沿路分散，而非聚成一团。一个孤立人影靠近道路右下方，成对或小组的人影向中左的远处退去。左前景长满干黄高草，深蓝、橄榄与棕色笔触交错，其中散着白、黄与红色小花点。右前景较浅也较空，一道磨旧的窄路痕斜向大路。多云日光漫射而偏冷，使白山墙和道路成为相连的最亮区域，草地与附属屋则保有更多阴影。颜料在灰天空里粗糙且薄擦，前景植物中更厚也更多彩。细深色记号确定人影、窗洞和杆线，却没有刻画得过分精确。略高的视点让道路从近画边斜引进安静的远方聚落。整体构图以宽阔低调天空和浅色建筑形体平衡活跃的金黄路边草地，细小分散的剪影传达人间尺度。
style_prompt_en: Loosely brushed oil paint combines large rubbed gray and blue-gray fields with a denser, more chromatic lower texture. Muted ochre and straw yellow gather near the front, interrupted by tiny white, red, and blue marks, while pale cream areas form the central light path. Edges stay soft and weathered across broad masses; small dark notations make select distant details legible without enclosing them. Thin scratches and dry drag marks remain visible in the quiet upper region, and thicker broken touches enliven the foreground. Overcast light keeps shadows shallow and cool, allowing value grouping rather than hard highlights to guide the eye. A diagonal open strip recedes through sparse compact accents, creating depth within an otherwise subdued atmosphere. The overall effect is modest, tactile, and gently melancholic.
style_prompt_zh: 松散油画笔触把大块擦薄的灰与蓝灰区域，同下部更密、更有色彩的纹理结合。低饱和赭色与稻草黄聚在近处，被细小白、红、蓝色记号打断，浅奶油色区域形成中央亮色通道。大形体边缘柔软且磨旧，细暗色标记只让选定的远处细节可读，并不把它们完全圈住。安静的上部区域保留细刮痕和干拖笔，下部前景用较厚的断笔活跃起来。阴天光让阴影浅而冷，由明度分组而非硬高光引导视线。一条斜向开放色带在稀疏紧凑的强调之间退向深处，于低调氛围里建立纵深。整体效果朴素、有触感并略带忧郁。
theme_en: Small figures crossing a pale road beside cottages under a gray sky
theme_zh: 灰色天空下，细小人影穿过乡屋旁的浅色道路
name: Joan Eardley
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
